# Pull Request

## What Changed

Describe the change in clear terms.

## Why It Matters

Explain the problem this solves or the workflow it improves.

## Related Assumptions

List any physical assumptions, engineering constraints, units, equations, or model boundaries involved in this change.

## Tests

Describe tests added or updated.

- [ ] Added automated tests
- [ ] Updated existing tests
- [ ] Performed manual validation
- [ ] Tests are not applicable because:

## Documentation

Describe documentation added or updated.

- [ ] Updated README or docs
- [ ] Updated examples
- [ ] Updated comments or docstrings
- [ ] Documentation is not applicable because:

## Security Considerations

Describe any security implications, including unsafe code execution, exposed secrets, insecure dependencies, weak input validation, or agent automation risks.

## AI Assistance

If an AI coding agent helped create this change, briefly describe how it was used and what you verified manually.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and reviewable.
- [ ] Assumptions and limitations are explicit.
- [ ] Units and validation rules are documented where relevant.
- [ ] Tests cover normal, boundary, and invalid cases where relevant.
- [ ] The change does not overclaim production readiness or physical validity.
